text_block_list.text:
The day of Ligne Droite.
In stark contrast to the students caught up in the festivities across campus, one Umamusume was running across the track.
Ligne Droite is a Tracen Academy dance party held at the end of the school year to celebrate farewells and the coming new year.

It's an event that most students would eagerly look forward to, but...
she has only just recovered from her injury.
Perhaps her impatience to race is building up.

Watching over her, ready to stop her if she started pushing herself too hard...
a small shadow suddenly darted onto the track.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: What are you doing, Chiyono O!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Teio-san!
...And Trainer-san, too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't it raining out today?
What're you doing running on the track all by yourself?"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Anyone would be worried, you know!
...Did something happen?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Huh, whoa! Did I make you worry!?
I'm so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Um, well, uh...
Her round eyes wandered aimlessly through the air... and eventually, she confessed as if giving up.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "To be honest, I'm just not really in the mood for dancing right now. Running makes me feel more at ease, I guess... Ahaha."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, of course I'm being careful with the workload!
It's just...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I think about the upcoming Classic Triple Crown races,
I just can't sit still.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Especially the Japan Derby. It's a "special" race entrusted to me by the one I admire most.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
That's why... I can't lose!
No matter the situation, no matter who my rival is...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...An important race that was entrusted to me, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Since I haven't debuted yet, I don't really understand
the true passion of that place at all. But—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I kinda get how you feel when you're fired up.
...I have someone I look up to, too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wanting to chase after that back, wanting to win the same race...
Knowing I'd do anything for that gets me fired up and gives me chills!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Teio-san.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: —Hey, Chiyono O.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "Ligne Droite is held as a milestone for every student to gain momentum from their progress and take their next step forward."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: The Umamusume I look up to said this:

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Taking yet another step forward—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah. So—

Tokai Teio cheerfully extended
her right hand toward Sakura Chiyono O.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Take my hand, Chiyono O!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Sometimes just running all the time can end up wearing you down.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Come dance with me and catch your breath.
I'm sure you'll become even stronger after that!

Sakura Chiyono O timidly reached out her hand,
and then slowly froze mid-air.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ugh... But, I, um--

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...Uuugh, I'm sorry!
Right now, there's just no way
I can focus on dancing!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Aww, that's too bad!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "Ah, but! I was really happy that you invited me!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, listening to you talk, I realized
that I was being way too impatient..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
So today, I've decided to just take the plunge,
wrap things up right here, and get some rest!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ! Ahaha, you really are pretty tough, aren't you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
A word of praise! Here, this is for you!
Let's give it our best tomorrow, too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Eh, what!?

Tokai Teio shoved a Hachimi Drink into Sakura Chiyono O's hands
and headed home in a flash.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...They left.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...You brought this for me too? Hehe,
you're so kind, Teio-san!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Mm! D-Delicious!

The next day, I was greeted by the sight of her
full of drive and pumped to give it her all once more.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
See?! Two to one, it's decided!
Let's go, if we don't hurry it'll be over!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ah, b-but I don't have a dress ready!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Then let's both do it in our school uniforms!
A uniform dance!
And so, the two of them danced out onto the floor in their school uniforms—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
One-two-three, one-two-three!
Nhehe, look at you go!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ehehe...! It's all thanks to Teio-san's lead!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Alright, next is a power-up!
The Teio Original Step!

Riding the upbeat rhythm,
the two of them danced with energetic, nimble stepsâ

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Whoaa!
Y-You're so fast, Teio-san!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I can totally keep going--!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wah, ...ff, haha!
Ahahahahaha!
We spent a night full of endless smiles.
